note: A concrete migration path with a window and a removal date.
title: Replace v1 user endpoints with v2
body:
Replaces the endpoints.

Migration Plan: /v1/users/:id/email and /v1/users/:id/profile keep working, with a Deprecation header, until 2027-03-31. Consumers move to GET /v2/users/:id, which returns both fields. The mobile and billing teams have confirmed their cutover dates in the linked thread.
